snippets.title: Wiper motor supply voltage check
snippets.text: Applies to all vehicles with a single front wiper motor. If the wipers do not move on any speed, key on and set the wiper switch to low. Back-probe the low-speed terminal at the wiper motor connector and read the voltage to a known-good ground. It should be within 1 V of battery voltage.

snippets.title: Rear washer pump inoperative after freezing
snippets.text: Applies to hatchbacks and SUVs with a rear washer, model years 2015-2019. After a hard freeze the rear washer pump may hum without spraying. Check the rear washer hose at the liftgate hinge for ice or a kink. Repair: reroute the hose with the updated clip.

messages.content: 2014 midsize sedan, 2.4L four-cylinder, 131k miles. The front wipers stopped working completely, on every speed including mist. The washer still squirts. Where do I start?

reply: With the key on and the wiper switch on low, back-probe the low-speed terminal at the wiper motor connector and read the voltage to a known-good ground; it should be within 1 V of battery voltage [WM-118].

snippets.title: Dual-sender fuel gauge comparison, saddle tanks
snippets.text: Applies to all-wheel-drive SUVs with a saddle fuel tank and two level senders. When the gauge reads low for several minutes after refueling and then corrects itself, compare the gauge with the cluster data display of both sender readings. The two senders should agree within about an eighth of a tank once the fuel has settled.

snippets.title: Fuel gauge reads empty or jumps from a worn level sender
snippets.text: Applies to compact sedans with a single in-tank fuel level sender, model years 2015-2019. The fuel gauge may read empty after refueling, or jump between empty and half, because the sender wiper wears a flat spot on its resistor card. With the key off, unplug the sender connector at the fuel pump module and read the resistance across the sender terminals with an ohmmeter. Expect about 40 ohms with a full tank and about 250 ohms near empty, with no open circuit. Repair: replace the fuel level sender.

messages.content: Working on a 2017 compact sedan (2.0L, front-wheel drive, 76k miles). After I fill the tank the fuel gauge still points at empty, and once in a while it jumps to half and back. The low fuel light comes on too.

reply: The saddle-tank procedure covers all-wheel-drive SUVs with two senders, so it doesn't fit this front-wheel-drive sedan. With the key off, unplug the fuel level sender connector at the pump module and read the resistance across the sender terminals; with a full tank it should be close to 40 ohms and never open [SI 7.4.2].

snippets.title: Weak horn tone in cold weather
snippets.text: Applies to compact pickups with dual-tone horns, model years 2019-2022. Below 20 deg F the horn may sound weak or single-toned for the first minutes of driving. Inspect the horn vent for ice or water. Repair: install the revised vented horn.

snippets.title: Headlamp switch circuit voltage drop test
snippets.text: Applies to all vehicles with halogen headlamps. With the low beams on, measure the voltage drop from the battery positive post to the headlamp connector feed terminal. It should be under 0.5 V.

messages.content: 2012 midsize sedan, 3.0L V6, 158k miles. The horn does nothing at all when I press the pad, no click, no sound. It's summer, so it's not a cold-weather thing. Just tell me what part to replace.

reply: None of the provided references cover a completely silent horn on this sedan: the horn bulletin applies only to 2019-2022 pickups with a weak tone in the cold, so I can't point to a documented step or a part yet. Can you share the service-manual section for the horn circuit?

snippets.title: Door lock actuator command check
snippets.text: Applies to all vehicles with power door locks. With a scan tool, command each door lock actuator to lock and unlock while listening at each door. An actuator that does not respond while the others do points to that actuator or its wiring.

snippets.title: Slow or stalling front window in cold weather
snippets.text: Applies to compact SUVs with one-touch front windows, model years 2014-2018. The driver's window may move slowly or stall partway in cold weather when the glass run channel stiffens and binds. Clamp an inductive ammeter around the window motor feed wire and run the glass up through its full travel. A motor moving freely draws about 5-8 A; draw above 12 A before the glass reaches the top points to binding in the glass run channel or regulator. Repair: install the revised low-friction glass run channel.

messages.content: 2016 compact SUV, 2.5L, 99k miles. The driver's window goes up really slowly and stalls halfway when it's cold out. I already know it's the regulator, I don't want a diagnosis. Which regulator do I order?

reply: I can't name a part to order until the slowdown is measured. Clamp an inductive ammeter around the driver's window motor feed and read the current while running the glass up; a motor moving freely should draw about 5-8 A [PW-3307].
